sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, who sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and a recent win over Eccleshall, don't have any fixtures listed for the coming week. Their last match was the 2-0 victory at home against Eccleshall on 19 September, where goals from Josh Fowles and Kyle Foley secured the three points despite playing the final period with ten men.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town drew 3-3 at home with Cheadle Heath Nomads after going down to 10 men, extending their unbeaten run but dropping points. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth suffered their first loss, going down 1-0 to Brereton Social, while Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) won 3-1 away at Shawbury United to maintain their strong form. Eccleshall (5th) dropped points in their 2-0 defeat to table-toppers Sandbach. Mid-table Bilston Town (6th) dominated Market Drayton 3-0 at home, and Barnton (7th) secured a valuable 2-0 away win at struggling Telford Town. New Mills (8th) fell to a 2-1 home loss against Dawley Town. Wednesfield Community (9th) earned their first clean sheet with a 1-0 away win at Crewe, while Allscott Heath (11th) bounced back impressively with a 4-1 home demolition of bottom-placed Alsager Town.
